sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p':
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            out['purple']=f"rows{r0}-{r1} cols{c0}-{c1}"
    # check if any pixel in purple region is W
    out['purple_W'] = any(b[r][c]=='W' for r in range(21,42) for c in range(33,39))
    greens=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=8:
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            greens.append(((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2, b[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]))
    out['greens']=greens
    return out
print('before', state())
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':35}]); print('after click purple', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
